metadata.name: SBP Cloud Outsourcing Framework
metadata.description: The State Bank of Pakistan Cloud Outsourcing Framework provides regulatory requirements for financial institutions in Pakistan to adopt cloud computing services while managing associated risks and ensuring regulatory compliance.
metadata.classification_reasoning: The SBP Cloud Outsourcing Framework is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan for financial institutions seeking to adopt cloud services. It requires compliance reporting and regulatory approval for certain cloud arrangements.
metadata.framework_purpose: To provide regulatory requirements and guidelines for financial institutions in Pakistan to safely and securely adopt cloud computing services while maintaining data sovereignty, privacy, and operational resilience.
metadata.framework_scope: All financial institutions regulated by the State Bank of Pakistan, including banks, DFIs, microfinance banks, and other entities under SBP's supervisory purview seeking to use cloud computing services.
framework_objectives: Establish governance framework for cloud adoption decisions
Ensure comprehensive risk assessment before cloud adoption
Protect customer data and maintain data sovereignty
Maintain regulatory compliance in cloud environments
Ensure business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities
Enable effective oversight and audit of cloud service providers
metadata.target_audience: CIOs, CISOs, IT Governance Teams, Compliance Officers, Procurement Teams, and Board Members of SBP-regulated financial institutions
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance may result in regulatory penalties, restrictions on cloud adoption, and enforcement actions as per SBP regulations.
metadata.adoption_approach: Risk-based implementation with periodic compliance reporting. Financial institutions must obtain SBP approval before adopting material cloud arrangements.

controls.title: Board Approved Cloud Strategy
controls.description: The Board of Directors shall approve a cloud computing strategy that aligns with the institution's overall IT and business strategy.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall develop and maintain a Board-approved cloud computing strategy that is aligned with the overall IT strategy and business objectives. The strategy shall clearly define the institution's approach to cloud adoption, including types of cloud services and deployment models permitted.

controls.title: Cloud Governance Framework
controls.description: Establish a governance framework defining roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes for cloud computing.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish a cloud governance framework that defines roles, responsibilities, accountability, and decision-making authority for cloud-related matters. The framework shall include oversight mechanisms and reporting structures.

controls.title: Cloud Policy Documentation
controls.description: Develop and maintain comprehensive cloud computing policies and procedures.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive cloud computing policies and procedures covering all aspects of cloud adoption, operation, and management. Policies shall be reviewed and updated at least annually.

controls.title: SBP Notification Requirements
controls.description: Notify SBP before adopting material cloud computing arrangements as per regulatory requirements.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall notify and obtain approval from SBP before entering into material cloud computing arrangements. The notification shall include details of the arrangement, risk assessment results, and security controls to be implemented.

controls.title: Cloud Risk Assessment
controls.description: Conduct comprehensive risk assessment before adopting any cloud services.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall conduct a comprehensive risk assessment before adopting any cloud computing services. The assessment shall identify, analyze, and evaluate all risks associated with the proposed cloud arrangement including operational, security, legal, and compliance risks.

controls.title: Data Classification for Cloud
controls.description: Classify data based on sensitivity before determining cloud eligibility.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall classify all data based on sensitivity and criticality before determining eligibility for cloud storage or processing. Highly sensitive data categories shall be identified and appropriate controls defined for their cloud migration.

controls.title: Concentration Risk Management
controls.description: Assess and manage concentration risk when using cloud service providers.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall assess concentration risk arising from reliance on specific cloud service providers or geographic locations. Measures shall be implemented to mitigate concentration risk including exit strategies and alternative provider arrangements.

controls.title: Ongoing Risk Monitoring
controls.description: Implement continuous monitoring of cloud-related risks throughout the service lifecycle.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement ongoing monitoring of cloud-related risks throughout the service lifecycle. Key risk indicators shall be defined and monitored, with regular reporting to senior management and the Board.

controls.title: Cloud Provider Due Diligence
controls.description: Conduct thorough due diligence on cloud service providers before engagement.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall conduct thorough due diligence on potential cloud service providers before engagement. Due diligence shall cover financial stability, security capabilities, regulatory compliance, operational resilience, and track record.

controls.title: Security Certification Verification
controls.description: Verify cloud providers maintain relevant security certifications and compliance.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall verify that cloud service providers maintain relevant security certifications (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) and comply with applicable regulatory requirements. Certification status shall be monitored on an ongoing basis.

controls.title: Subcontractor Assessment
controls.description: Assess and approve material subcontractors used by cloud service providers.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall assess material subcontractors and fourth parties used by cloud service providers. The right to approve or reject subcontractors handling sensitive data shall be contractually established.

controls.title: Cloud Contract Requirements
controls.description: Ensure cloud contracts include mandatory provisions for security, audit, and regulatory compliance.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure that cloud service contracts include mandatory provisions covering security requirements, audit rights, regulatory compliance, data ownership, incident notification, and termination rights.

controls.title: Service Level Agreements
controls.description: Establish comprehensive SLAs with cloud service providers covering availability and performance.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish comprehensive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with cloud service providers covering availability, performance, incident response times, and penalties for non-compliance. SLAs shall be monitored and enforced.

controls.title: Exit Strategy and Data Portability
controls.description: Establish clear exit strategy and ensure data portability in cloud arrangements.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish a clear exit strategy for cloud arrangements, including provisions for data portability, transition assistance, and secure data destruction. Exit procedures shall be tested periodically.

controls.title: Audit Rights
controls.description: Ensure contractual rights for audit and inspection of cloud service providers.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure contractual rights to audit and inspect cloud service providers, including their facilities, systems, and processes. Audit rights shall extend to SBP and external auditors as required.

controls.title: Identity and Access Management
controls.description: Implement strong identity and access management controls for cloud environments.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement strong identity and access management controls for cloud environments, including multi-factor authentication, privileged access management, and regular access reviews.

controls.title: Data Encryption
controls.description: Implement encryption for data at rest and in transit in cloud environments.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement strong encryption for data at rest and in transit in cloud environments. Encryption keys shall be managed securely, with preference for customer-managed keys for sensitive data.

controls.title: Network Security
controls.description: Implement network security controls for cloud environments including segmentation and monitoring.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement network security controls for cloud environments including network segmentation, firewall rules, intrusion detection, and traffic monitoring. Secure connectivity to cloud environments shall be established.

controls.title: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Implement vulnerability management processes for cloud-hosted systems and applications.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement vulnerability management processes for cloud-hosted systems and applications. Regular vulnerability assessments shall be conducted, and identified vulnerabilities shall be remediated in accordance with risk-based timelines.

controls.title: Security Monitoring and Logging
controls.description: Implement comprehensive security monitoring and logging for cloud environments.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement comprehensive security monitoring and logging for cloud environments. Logs shall be retained for the required period, protected from tampering, and regularly reviewed for security events.

controls.title: Data Residency Requirements
controls.description: Ensure compliance with data residency requirements for cloud-stored data.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure compliance with data residency requirements. Customer data and critical data shall be stored within Pakistan unless specific approval is obtained from SBP. Data location shall be clearly defined in contracts.

controls.title: Data Privacy Compliance
controls.description: Ensure compliance with data privacy requirements in cloud environments.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure compliance with applicable data privacy requirements in cloud environments. Privacy controls shall be implemented, and privacy impact assessments shall be conducted for cloud arrangements involving personal data.

controls.title: Data Segregation
controls.description: Ensure logical segregation of data from other cloud tenants.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure logical segregation of their data from other cloud tenants. Isolation controls shall be verified and tested. Shared infrastructure risks shall be assessed and mitigated.

controls.title: Secure Data Destruction
controls.description: Ensure secure destruction of data when cloud services are terminated.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure secure destruction of data when cloud services are terminated or data is no longer required. Destruction certificates shall be obtained from cloud service providers, and verification shall be performed where possible.

controls.title: Cloud Business Continuity Planning
controls.description: Include cloud services in business continuity planning and testing.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall include cloud services in their business continuity planning. Recovery procedures for cloud-dependent services shall be documented and tested. Cloud service provider BCPs shall be reviewed and aligned with institutional requirements.

controls.title: Cloud Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Establish disaster recovery capabilities for cloud-hosted systems and data.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish disaster recovery capabilities for cloud-hosted systems and data. Recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO) shall be defined and tested. Geographic redundancy shall be considered for critical systems.

controls.title: Cloud Backup Management
controls.description: Implement backup procedures for cloud-hosted data and systems.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement backup procedures for cloud-hosted data and systems. Backups shall be tested regularly for recoverability. Backup data shall be protected with the same security controls as primary data.

controls.title: Cloud Audit Program
controls.description: Establish an audit program for cloud service arrangements.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish an audit program for cloud service arrangements. The program shall include regular audits of cloud controls, review of provider audit reports, and assessment of compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.

controls.title: Cloud Performance Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor cloud service performance against defined service levels.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall monitor cloud service performance against defined service levels. Performance metrics shall be tracked, reported, and used to identify improvement opportunities. SLA breaches shall be escalated and addressed.

controls.title: Cloud Incident Management
controls.description: Establish incident management procedures for cloud-related security incidents.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish incident management procedures for cloud-related security incidents. Procedures shall include incident detection, response, escalation, and notification to SBP as required. Post-incident reviews shall be conducted.

controls.title: Regulatory Reporting
controls.description: Submit periodic reports to SBP on cloud computing arrangements.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall submit periodic reports to SBP on their cloud computing arrangements as required. Reports shall include information on cloud services in use, significant incidents, and compliance status.

controls.title: Continuous Improvement
controls.description: Implement continuous improvement processes for cloud governance and security.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement continuous improvement processes for cloud governance and security. Lessons learned from incidents, audits, and operational issues shall be incorporated into improvements. Emerging cloud security threats shall be monitored and addressed.
